name: Partner Donkey Calf Raise
how_to:
1. Foot Placement: Stand on a secure block or platform with just the balls of your feet supported and heels hanging off the edge.
2. Torso Position: Bend forward at the hips to form a roughly 90° angle. Place your hands on a secure bench, rail, or platform for stability. Keep your back flat and knees fully extended.
3. Partner Loading: Your partner carefully mounts your hips/lower back area and sits evenly. They should distribute weight without applying direct pressure to the spine or ribs.
4. Starting Position: Begin with your heels fully lowered to achieve a deep calf stretch.
5. Initiate the Lift: Raise your heels by pressing through the balls of your feet, contracting your calves forcefully.
6. Top Squeeze: Hold at the top for 1–2 seconds, focusing on full plantarflexion.
7. Controlled Descent: Lower the heels back below the block level under slow control, reestablishing the stretch.
8. Repeat: Complete the desired number of reps, maintaining a consistent tempo and posture throughout.
